title: Derive native Windows build roots and caches from the lane identifier
body: The native scripts inherited native_root=/mnt/c/vixen-native/nativerunner-glyphsdf and NATIVE_CACHE_ROOT=C:\vixen-native\nativerunner\.tmp. To preserve worktree isolation, I had to assign this lane its own C:\vixen-native\vixendll checkout and .tmp/fetch cache. Derive both roots from the lane identifier in the shared native runner so each lane gets an isolated checkout and cache without editing scripts by hand.

title: Keep native build mutex waits alive in the shared box queue
body: run_build_with_summary.ps1 prints one waiting line then blocks in WaitOne for up to 1800s; the shared queue killed a legitimate native build job after 199s with no output while nativerunner-glyphsdf owned the mutex. Add periodic wait progress from the native runner or queue activity signaling without weakening the machine-wide build lock. Tier luna because this is a scoped runner-loop change with a queue witness.

title: Regenerate stale FrameTargets schema and Ref outputs on native builds
body: The first queued native build (`bash reports/capturespeed/reproduce/native-build.sh 781332fa7b0e14015e12505ca3a9a0ad15b146a5`) failed in ALL at frame_targets_schema_check because the auto-discovered Undertow schema inputs had advanced; frame_targets_ref_check was stale behind it. Recovery required separately running `cmake --build <native-build-dir> --target frame_targets_schema_regen` and then `cmake --build <native-build-dir> --target frame_targets_ref_regen` through the build queue before the fresh native build passed. Make this source-stage/generator dependency update declarative so a native build does not need manual recovery-only regeneration.

title: Allow the native build runner to sync a reviewed dirty worktree
body: The required native build command bash reports/capturespeed/reproduce/native-build.sh exited before configuration with 'refusing to sync a dirty VIXEN tree; commit the runner change first'. I had to commit the current implementation before the runner could sync and build it. Consider making the runner snapshot the current reviewed tree with an explicit opt-in while preserving the commit-pinned default for reproducible reports.

title: Wire Windows HUD capture assertions to their producer fixture
body: On Windows, test_critical_nodes.cmake registers test_rendergraph_criticalnodes_windowedcapture without the FIXTURES_REQUIRED or TEST_ENVIRONMENT provided on Linux. HudRenderCapture therefore reads the default temp directory while vixen_hud_capture_producer writes to the build-tree runtime-captures/hud directory, and the consumers run before the producer in the full CTest order. I had to run the producer first and set VIXEN_HUD_CAPTURE_DIR manually to make the three identity checks pass. Make the producer fixture dependency and absolute output directory declarative for native Windows CTest too.

title: Make disabled diagnostic-shader tests runnable with a declared fixture
body: The full native CTest run marks UberShaderSplice.CompileDiagnosticShaderDirectory Not Run (Disabled). To produce a real result, I had to create a temporary CTestTestfile.cmake with the DISABLED_ gtest filter, environment, and timeout. The test then failed on both base and lane before shader compilation because BOUNDSCORE_DIAGNOSTIC_SHADER_DIR was unset. Declare a scratch diagnostic-shader fixture/output directory and register a supported explicit CTest job so this test can be run and reported without a hand-built driver.

title: Derive executable status manifests from complete CTest results
body: After the all-tests CTest run stopped at test 3031, the executable manifest did not merge the resumed per-test runs 3031-3056. The earlier per-executable summary also marked test_connection_concepts as 25 passed and 5 unreached even though CTest recorded all 30 cases as Passed. I had to reconcile and correct a run2 manifest by hand. Derive per-executable outcomes from CTest result records and merge resumed slices so the reported status matches actual test results.
